summary.description: One or two sentences: the verdict for this lens.

file.description: Path relative to the repository root.

line.description: Line in the new version of the file; for deleted code, the nearest remaining line.

category.description: Short kebab-case slug, such as sql-injection, race-condition or missing-timeout.

title.description: The defect in one line, at most 80 characters.

failure_scenario.description: The concrete input or state, and the wrong outcome it produces.

evidence.description: The code and call path that prove it, with file:line references.

suggested_fix.description: The smallest change that removes the defect.

confidence.description: 0.0 to 1.0: how sure you are that this is a real defect.
